name: Deltempo
description: Free, portable, open-source Windows disk cleaner, RAM optimizer, deep app uninstaller, and duplicate file finder. Zero telemetry, 100% local, no installer required.
author: Beso1227
capabilities: 26+ cleaning scopes including GPU shader caches, browser caches and developer build artifacts
Native NT kernel standby memory trim (EmptyWorkingSet, NtSetSystemInformation)
Deep root application uninstallation with leftover cleanup
Read-only AppData footprint report with orphaned Microsoft Store app detection
Deliberate refusal of load-bearing paths that look like scratch (MSI source caches, per-user .NET SDK install root, bare driver vendor roots, cargo registry src, Audacity session recovery)
Per-directory AppData durable-state protection so a recursive purge cannot remove OneDrive, Office credentials, vaults, jump lists or key material as collateral
CLI headless automation for CI/CD and PowerShell
limitations: Windows 10 and 11 on x64 only; no macOS, Linux, ARM64, or 32-bit build
Cleaning is limited to an explicit allowlist of disposable scopes; load-bearing paths are refused by design
The memory optimizer flushes the standby list and trims working sets: cache eviction, not additional physical RAM
Optional AI verdicts need a user-supplied API key and network access; offline heuristics run without one
Localization is partial: Cleaner workspace only (en, ar, es, fr, de); other workspaces remain English
The Chris Titus Tech WinUtil launcher is third-party and outside Deltempo's safety audit
